description_en: Assigns a public IP address to an ECS instance. We recommend that you call the ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec operation to assign a public IP address
description_zh: 为一台ECS实例分配一个公网IP地址。推荐您使用接口ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec分配公网IP
name: AllocatePublicIpAddress

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the instance to which you want to allocate a public IP address.

The public bandwidth of the instance must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh:
待分配IP地址的实例ID。

该实例带宽必须大于0
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The public IP address of the instance. If this parameter is left empty, the system randomly assigns an IP address.

Only users in the whitelist can specify this parameter. Regular users cannot specify an IP address
parameters.help_zh:
实例的公网IP地址。如果该参数值为空，则默认由系统随机分配IP地址。

该参数只支持白名单用户指定，普通用户不支持指定IP地址
parameters.name: ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The VLAN ID of the instance.
This parameter will be deprecated. For better compatibility, use other parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例的VLAN ID。
该参数即将被弃用，为提高兼容性，请尽量使用其他参数
parameters.name: vlan_id

IpAddress.description_en: The public IP address of the instance
